blocks.text: A Lanao del Sur court has issued orders to arrest Levito “Levi” Baligod along with the 18 witnesses under his watch for cyberlibel charges filed by a lawmaker. The arrest warrant was issued by Presiding Judge Samina Sampaco Macabando-Usman of Branch 8 of the Marawi City Regional Trial Court, with a bail set at P30,000 for each of the accused. It was not stated in the arrest warrant who the complainant was. But it will be recalled that Lanao del Sur Rep.
